title: How One Question Before You Correct Him Keeps a Godly Man Gentle
caption:
Before you correct him, a godly man corrects himself first.

Galatians 6:1 puts the warning on you, not him: restore him gently, watching yourself so you're not tempted the same way. Ask what you'd have to admit if someone was this honest about you. If the answer makes you flinch, lead with that.

Correct the sin, not the man. There's a difference between "you did something wrong" and "you are the problem," and only one of those a brother can actually hear. Say it to his face first, or don't say it at all.

#faith #humility #christianmen #manofgod #brotherhood #character
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
